messages:
Alex (Design): heads up — noticed a hit-target regression when a toast appears over a stacked modal in compact spacing. close button becomes hard to tap on trackpads and phones :grimacing:
Sam - Eng: can you paste a repro or a quick screenshot?
Alex (Design): repro steps: open Settings -> Connections, open 'Add connection' modal, save to trigger toast while modal still open. attached screenshot. quick CSS I inspected:```css
.modal { transform: translateZ(0); z-index: 900; }
.toast { position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 24px; z-index: 1000; }
.button.close { padding: 4px; /* reduced by --space-compact */ }
```
Toast ends up sitting visually above the close icon, and because the modal wrapper has a transform the close's z-index can't escape that stacking context. compact spacing tokens have shrunk the hit area below ~44px in some spots.
Dom (Design Systems): hmm, tokens shouldn't allow hit targets under 44px. we intentionally set that as the min but looks like compact alias inheritance bypassed it. might be time to add an explicit `--touch-target` token and an enforcement lint.
Maya P: +1 on min touch target and also keyboard a11y — when toast appears the focus outline gets partially obscured. focus-visible z needs to be above toasts or toasts should not overlap focused controls.
Sam - Eng: short-term quick fix: bump .modal .close { z-index: 1001; } but agree that's brittle. proper fix is to remove transform on modal container or ensure no stacking context traps the close button.
Alejandra (PM): small copy note — toast currently says "Saved" which is ambiguous when you have multiple saveable things open. suggest "Saved — connection updated" or "Saved changes to connection" to reduce confusion.
Alex (Design): agree on copy tweak. proposed action items: 1) enforce 44px min touch target via `--touch-target` token and update compact tokens to respect it, 2) change modal markup so close button is not trapped by stacking context (or ensure close has higher stacking without hacky overrides), 3) ensure toasts avoid covering focused elements — either reposition or lower opacity while an element is focused.
UI-bot: deploy-preview created for branch `modal-toast-hitbox-fix` — staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/pr/2304 — screenshots attached :eyes: :shipit:
Sam - Eng: tested on staging (Chrome + Safari on mac). close button is clickable, focus outline visible. noticed toast slide-in overlaps briefly during animation; might need easing/timing tweak (200ms -> 160ms feels snappier).
Alex (Design): noted timing nit. I'll update the motion tokens for toast enter/exit in the follow-up. merging later today if no objections. leaving a follow-up ticket to add a visual regression test for toast/modal stacking and a docs note about `--touch-target`. :thumbsup:
Alejandra (PM): thanks everyone — will update release notes copy to mention improved accessibility + clearer save messaging.
Sam - Eng: cool, closing the loop once merged.
Alex (Design): thanks all!
